breaking.change: Redrawn bare over the scene: the parts Nameplate.badge, Nameplate.well, Nameplate.track, Nameplate.tag and Nameplate.caption are gone (the level chip is Nameplate.level, the bar Nameplate.health with Nameplate.ghost, Nameplate.fill and Nameplate.shield, the cast row Nameplate.cast with Nameplate.spell, Nameplate.time and Nameplate.castbar). boss no longer stands for an elite.
breaking.fix: Restyle the new parts in a pack (::part(Nameplate.level), ::part(Nameplate.health)); pass elite for an elite and boss only for a boss.

breaking.change: A bar row's color is gone and its colour is its side (own, ally, enemy, neutral); the part OverheadBars.fill is gone.
breaking.fix: Give each row side instead of color, and resource and resourceMax for a resource line; restyle ::part(OverheadBars.bar).

breaking.change: The parts LootLabel.tag, LootLabel.cell and LootLabel.figure are gone: the label is LootLabel.chip with LootLabel.strip, LootLabel.name and LootLabel.count, and LootLabel.glow on the ground.

The parts InteractionPrompt.name, InteractionPrompt.label, InteractionPrompt.headline and InteractionPrompt.caption are gone: the object is InteractionPrompt.object, the cap InteractionPrompt.cap with InteractionPrompt.key, the words on InteractionPrompt.plate.
The shape disc is circle (empty is still a circle), and a ring's inner radius defaults to 0.45.
breaking.fix: Pass shape circle (or leave it empty) for a disc; pass inner 0 for a ring with no safe middle.

breaking.change: reaction is side (own, ally, enemy, neutral) and segmented is target.
breaking.fix: Pass side="enemy" for hostile and side="neutral" for neutral, target for segmented.

breaking.change: cells is a list of { id, blocked } with columns across; the parts PlacementGhost.zone, PlacementGhost.gridline and PlacementGhost.fill are gone (PlacementGhost.cell is a grid cell).
breaking.fix: Pass columns and one cells row per grid cell, blocked where it cannot be built; restyle ::part(PlacementGhost.footprint) and ::part(PlacementGhost.cell).

breaking.change: icon is gone (the pin is the kind's diamond); distance is the game's words, not a number (negative hid it, now empty does); the parts Waypoint.label, Waypoint.figure and Waypoint.tag are Waypoint.name and Waypoint.distance.
breaking.fix: Pass distance formatted (412) and empty for none; restyle ::part(Waypoint.name) and ::part(Waypoint.distance).

added.summary: Drawn to the world labels mockup: a level chip (gold for an elite or a boss, a skull for a boss without one), the name in the reaction's ink, its title in small tracked capitals, a skewed bar cut in quarters with a cream ghost that holds 400 ms and drains in 300 ms and a cyan shield after the fill, gold wings, the percent for a boss and at 25 % or less (its rim then danger, breathing, still under reduced motion), an amber cast row with castTime, castState locked (steel grey, a shield mark) and interrupted (a red hatch and the word), the target 1.14 times larger, white, bracketed, dead (Lootable in gold with lootable) and compact (the bar alone). A boss or a casting plate takes priority 400, over the interaction prompt's 300.
Health in the side's colour (own green, ally blue, enemy red, neutral yellow) and a thin resource line, each a GPU mass bar of a fixed size.

A dark chip with the tier's strip on its leading edge and the name in the tier's ink, a legendary's gold wash and rim and shimmer every 2.4 s, a glow of the tier on the ground and a beam for epic and legendary; hovered (or :hover) it lifts 1.06 times with its rim all round and the pick-up key (action); more and tiers draw one +n chip with a dot per tier; it pops in over 280 ms.

A key cap beside a glass plate, the verb in condensed capitals and the object under it; key, pad (a gamepad's round cap), pressed (the cap sinks 2 px and lights), hold (a white ring on a dark disc; done lights the cap; released it drains in 200 ms) and disabled (a grey cap, the reason in red with a lock); it rises 6 px and fades in over 160 ms.

Glass with a cut corner, the speaker in their reaction's ink, the line wrapping at 27 characters, a tail and left, a thin line of the time left; a shout's warm rim and bolder line; it pops from its tail in 180 ms.

A rim, a faint hatched wash and a fill sweeping out from the caster with a pale leading edge for a circle, cone, line or ring; hit flashes 120 ms then fades over 200 ms; an ally's is cyan without the hatch.
Own, ally, enemy and neutral rings with a soft glow, leader ticks, a segmented target turning every 8 s and a thin hover ring; it pops in over 140 ms.
A green lit footprint with its grid, a dashed reach ring and its cost on an upright badge under it; blocked, red with only the blocked cells hatched, and the reason.

A lit diamond with a dark core, the name in the kind's ink and the distance on a dark tag; range near (a halo), mid and far (the name drops); kinds ping (a ripple), danger, ally and loot; edge left or right draws a chevron toward it.
White dashes over a dark under-stroke, numbered stops, the part past this turn's reach red and the end ringed; its label on an upright badge beside the end; invalid red with a cross.
